I told him not to bring in the M$4,900 until the account is open.

He replied that exceptions have to go through Compliance and that he still needs the numbers. I didn't open Sanders' account, and I didn't push the check through. If Ian or the customer wants an exception, it has to go through Compliance with a formal approval token.

I've closed the shift with a handover note so whoever picks up Sanders' file knows to re-run KYC once the documents arrive.
